name: EPIC 230535187
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 10.8 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 9,574 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.03 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,831 K at its surface.
